name: Roommates, Romance, and Ringing Hearts
storyline:
You arrive in the city to begin your university life, full of dreams and expectations, only to lose your place to live due to an unexpected incident. Guided by fate, you move into a shared house.

There, you begin a year of shared living with five charming heroines, each with a completely different personality. From spring encounters to a winter holy night, your time at the share house is filled with unforgettable moments, including swimsuit shopping, Halloween, and a special Christmas.

A sweet and slightly silly shared life awaits.
summary:
Roommates, Romance, and Ringing Hearts is a live action FMV romance simulation game where your choices shape a year of love and relationships with five unique heroines.

Experience cinematic storytelling, heartfelt moments, and branching outcomes as everyday roommate life turns into romance.

Produced by TV Asahi Japan and Aiming Inc..
